body.name: Closed-form endpoint construction
body.construction: \(s_d^-=\min\{u_d,\max\{\ell_d,a_d\}\}\), \(s_d^+=\max\{\ell_d,b_d\}\), \(A_-=\sum_{d=1}^{L}(\ell_d-a_d)_+\), \(B_-=\sum_{d=1}^{L}s_d^-\), \(A_+=\sum_{d=1}^{L}b_d\), and \(B_+=\sum_{d=1}^{L}s_d^+\). The closed-form endpoint pair associated with these primitives is \((A_-/B_-,A_+/B_+)\).
